newsitem.title: USA: Silicon Graphics outlines fiscal Q1 charges.
newsitem.headline: Silicon Graphics outlines fiscal Q1 charges.

text.p: Silicon Graphics Inc, which reported a first fiscal quarter loss of $22 million, or $0.13 a share, after several special charges, said order delays ahead of last week's product launch hurt sales.

Prior to the special charges, the company posted a first quarter operating profit of $18 million, or $0.07 profit per share, compared with analyst mean estimates of $0.08 a share profit on a range of breakeven to a $0.13 a share.
Silicon Graphics Chairman and Chief Executive Edward McCracken, repeated that order delays ahead of the company's broadest product launch in years had hurt revenues.
